item.title: [AI & I by Every] How Hugging Face’s Investor Spots Winners
item.description:
Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:17 The Frontier duopoly is over. This week, we got new Frontier models from Google and from Meta. Google launched Gemini Argon four and Meta launched Wonder, which comes in standard and full. So you can run Wonder full, you know. That's their sense of humor.
Speaker 1 | 00:17 - 01:04 Of course, both new models from these pretty much second tier entrants in the frontier model race topped the benchmarks. But our hands on testing inside of every running running these models ...
